label: scam
title: Grandparent scam -- wire transfer for bail

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Grandma, it's me, please don't be mad.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I got in a car wreck and I'm in jail. Don't tell Dad, he'll kill me.

turns.speaker: victim
turns.text: Oh my goodness, what do you need?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: My lawyer needs $3,500 wired to post bail in the next hour or I stay the weekend.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please, just wire it to this account and don't tell anyone, it's embarrassing.
